parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.statut, t.total, t.fait, t.parametres->>'dossier' AS dossier, t.parametres->>'pilote' AS pilote, t.resultat, coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('etape', j.etape, 'outil', j.outil, 'resultat', j.resultat, 'duree_ms', j.duree_ms, 'choisi_par', j.choisi_par, 'raison', j.raison, 'accepte', j.accepte) ORDER BY j.id) FROM soins.sgb6_journal j WHERE j.tache_id = t.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS etapes FROM soins.taches t WHERE t.id = $1::uuid AND t.type = 'sgb6_agent'
SELECT s.identifiant, g.nom, s.jeton_hash FROM soins.sessions s JOIN soins.soignants g ON g.identifiant = s.identifiant WHERE s.jeton_hash = $1 AND s.expire_le > now() AND g.actif
